statessort.rationale: Everyday states support Grade 3 changes of state; the separate particle pictures support Grade 5 particle models.

creaturecare.rationale: Care choices and observations support needs in Grade 1 and growth/development in Grade 2. Percentages are fictional game rules.

literal-chaos.rationale: Flexible figurative-language practice and original comic creation. Difficulty bands are suggestions; teachers can choose expressions and provide reading support. The open comic task invites explanations and several defensible interpretations.

word-worlds.rationale: Flexible creative-language tool for exploring word choice, setting, mood, personification and viewpoint. The scene offers one authored interpretation; students can challenge it and support different readings. The 12 prompts are open experiments, not graded outcomes.
